videos.title: Best Free Open Source Backend as a Service Solutions
videos.description:
Let's compare 5 Free Open Source Backend as a Service Solutions to determine which is best for you and your projects.

In this video, we will compare Appwrite, PocketBase, Parse, Directus, and Supabase based on their different features:
- Authentication/Authorization
- Database
- File Storage
- Functions
- Transactional emails
- Integrations & SDK
